title: Home to Ithaca
beat: Odysseus finishes his tale and the Phaeacians sit in silence.
text: Thus did he speak, and they all held their peace throughout the covered cloister, enthralled by the charm of his story.
sees: Two women in lilac/pink tops stand on a small green island with a tall conifer, a round tree and a boulder; one wears a white crown. To the right a red ship with a black deck, white sail, mast and several brown oars; on it a bearded man in a red patterned shirt raises a gold goblet, and a second man in light clothes stands behind him. Blue studded sea with wave pieces, dusk sky.
doing: The man on the ship raises a cup toward, or in farewell to, the women on shore; the women gesture/reach toward the ship.
moment: A departure or arrival by ship with a farewell toast: likely Odysseus taking leave of the Phaeacians (Queen Arete and Nausicaa) with a libation cup, or a similar sea-farewell scene.
unclear: The women's legs are sunk into the island base; unclear whether ship is arriving or departing; the second man on the ship is partly hidden by the mast; who the crowned woman is is not obvious.

title: Home to Ithaca
beat: Alcinous orders additional gifts packed in a chest and the farewell feast begins.
text: They took the goods they had given him and put them on board the ship; they put the chest of gifts in the ship's hold.
sees: Two men on the deck of a red/black ship with mast and sail and oars: a grey-haired older man in white and light-blue trousers and a younger smiling brown-haired man. Between them is a brown chest/box with a curved lid. Island with tree and boulders at left, blue studded sea, dusk sky.
doing: The two men handle the chest together, as if loading, opening or closing it on board.
moment: Treasure or gifts being stowed aboard a ship before a voyage (e.g. Phaeacians loading Odysseus's gifts), or two sailors examining a treasure chest.
unclear: The chest looks more like a mechanism/winch than a box; hands merge with the lid; the lower bodies are cut off by the chest; who the men are is unclear.

title: Home to Ithaca
beat: At sunset Odysseus boards the convoy ship and lies on a prepared bed in the stern.
text: They spread a rug and a linen sheet on the deck at the stern, that he might sleep soundly, and he lay down without a word.
sees: Close view of a red ship with black deck, mast and many brown oars on a blue studded sea. On the deck a figure with gold hair and pink/red top lies on its back on a white and pink bed-like slab. Behind, a smiling figure in a white robe stands with both hands raised, and a grey-haired figure behind. Island with trees and boulder at right, dusk sky.
doing: One person lies asleep on a bed laid on the deck while the crew stand around/at the oars, rowing him along.
moment: A man carried asleep aboard a ship: Odysseus sleeping on the Phaeacian ship as it carries him home to Ithaca.
unclear: The sleeper's head and face are hidden behind the bed piece and the figure seems partly embedded in it; the standing crew's raised hands read ambiguously; oars float without rowers holding them.

title: Home to Ithaca
beat: The ship runs faster than a hawk while he sleeps and reaches Ithaca before dawn.
text: As four stallions bound together over the plain... even so did her prow curvet as it were the neck of a stallion, and a great wave of dark blue water seethed in her wake. She held steadily on her course, and even a falcon, swiftest of all birds, could not have kept pace with her.
sees: Night scene, dark sky. A red ship with black deck, brown mast and pale sail, oars out. A smiling figure in a white robe with brown hair stands with both hands raised; other figures are mostly hidden, some just raised hands visible over a white/pink slab. Tall translucent white columns of bricks rise from the sea behind the ship like waterspouts or spray. Island with trees and boulders to the right.
doing: The crew raise their hands (in alarm, prayer, or cheering) while the ship is surrounded by rising columns of water.
moment: A ship caught in a storm or among towering waves/waterspouts at night; possibly a god-sent storm on a voyage (e.g. Odysseus's crew or Jonah-type storm).
unclear: Figures are hidden behind the mast and deck slab, only disembodied hands visible; the translucent columns are ambiguous (water spouts? spray? ghosts?); the smiling face contradicts a storm reading.

title: Home to Ithaca
beat: The crew carries the sleeping man and his treasure onto the shore.
text: They lifted Ulysses with his rug and linen sheet out of the ship, and laid him down upon the sand still fast asleep. Then they took out the presents... and put them all together by the root of the olive tree, away from the road.
sees: Lego-style scene on a small sandy/green island on blue studded water. A mustached man in white shirt, red vest and grey cap stands at left behind an open brown treasure chest holding gold/silver cylinders. A figure with gold hair and red/pink clothing lies on its back on a pink/white slab under a large green tree. A big tan boulder with a grey one behind sits at right. Soft dusk light, calm mood.
doing: The figure lies asleep or unconscious on the ground; the mustached man stands over the chest and near the sleeper, as if having just set down the treasure or watching the sleeper.
moment: A sleeper left on a shore with treasure beside him: Odysseus set down asleep on Ithaca by the Phaeacian sailors, with their gifts piled by an olive tree. Could also be a castaway or treasure-burial scene.
unclear: The sleeper's face is hidden by the hair and the figure half-merges into the slab/bed piece; the standing man's legs are translucent/ghostly; the tree trunk runs through the sleeper; the scale of the boulder vs figures is odd.
